evidence: The IDE-bundled alpha Codex CLI ran without daemon reuse and with an explicit workspace-write sandbox.
Its operating-system permission preflight passed, but the agent tool router still rejected every command before execution.
The worker made no edits, so visible and hidden acceptance tests remained failing.
corrective_action: Replace the IDE-bundled alpha executable with the official standalone stable Codex CLI, freeze that harness version, and retry as a new immutable attempt.
